d: Pakistan is considering a major shake-up that could redraw its map and replace four provinces with 12. Defence Minister Khawaja Asif has backed the proposal, which is being presented as a way to improve governance and administration. But breaking up powerful provincial strongholds could also shift the balance of power towards Islamabad and Pakistan's military establishment. With Field Marshal Asim Munir consolidating his influence, could this map redraw become another power grab? Palki Sharma tells you.
